articles.text: At a cocktail party, Molina and Carmen ask how the Harrises fared. White says he left them at home and asks how Mrs. Harris liked the city; she liked it but was nervous about the traffic and noise. White explains that he felt the same when he first arrived but is now getting used to everything, even the constant parties. Later they recall a previous party that turned out fantastic; they danced all night and were the last to leave.
